title: Common complex representatives for self Ext and self Tor
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z to Y of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], a natural number n and the supplied derived category on Y [def-pc-derived-category], set B=i_*O_Z, G=H^n(RHom_Y(B[0],B[0])) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and Q=i^*H^(-n)(B[0] tensor^L B[0]) using the fixed tensor and ordinary tensor pullback [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure, def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist cochain complexes T,J on Z [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with H^k(J)=0 for k different from zero, and isomorphisms H^0(J) with O_Z, i^*G with H^n(Hom^bullet(T,J)) [def-pur-hom-complex], and Q with H^(-n)(T). For every open V of Z and affine U of Y whose immersion ideal is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], termwise restriction F to V and then its over site over V intersect i^(-1)(U) [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] makes F(J) K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and F(T) admit a finite free zero-differential model by a quasi-isomorphism roof, in the explicit sense used in [lem-sc-homology-evaluation-formal-complex]. No morphism from i^*G into the dual of Q is part of this assertion.

source.place: duality.tex, lemma-regular-ideal-ext, quotient Koszul Hom model; cohomology.tex, section-internal-hom (08DH), remark-pullback-internal-hom (08I3), evaluation mate; the internal pullback/direct-image isomorphism follows from derived adjunction, the pullback tensor comparison and Yoneda; modules.tex, lemma-i-star-equivalence (08KS); more-algebra.tex, equation-simple-tor-product (068G).

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution of B[0] and tensor-pull it back termwise to Z, obtaining T representing Li^*B. Choose a K-injective resolution J of O_Z[0]. Its augmentation induces e0:H^0(J) isomorphic to O_Z and makes all other cohomology zero.

The internal derived pullback/direct-image adjunction identifies RHom_Y(B,i_*O_Z) with Ri_*RHom_Z(Li^*B,O_Z). This is the Yoneda identification obtained by testing against A, transposing to Hom(A tensor B,Ri_*O_Z), applying derived pullback/direct-image adjunction and the pullback tensor comparison, and transposing back. Closed-immersion pushforward is exact. Hence its homology is i_*H^n(Hom(T,J)); the invertible ordinary pullback counit gives eG. Compute RHom by the actual K-injective Hom complex, and compare the representative computation with the supplied localization on Y.

Apply the quasi-coherent derived projection formula to the closed immersion, E=O_Z[0] and K=B[0]. Since closed immersions are affine, quasi-compact and quasi-separated and B is quasi-coherent, this identifies B tensor^L B with i_*(Li^*B). Exact pushforward and the same invertible pullback counit identify Q with H^(-n)(T), giving eQ.

On a regular affine chart use the Koszul projective resolution and its sheafified augmentation to compute the restriction of Li^*B. The quotient kills every Koszul generator, so the tensor complex has zero differential, finite support and finite free exterior-power terms. Resolution comparison gives a quasi-isomorphism roof from the restriction of T to this model. Open restriction, including the further V and over-site restrictions, preserves the roof, freeness and zero differentials. Open restriction preserves K-injectivity of J. Empty charts, zero quotients and empty generator families require no exceptions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_selfExt_tor_resolution_model
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    ∃ (T J : CochainComplex Z.Modules ℤ)
      (hJ : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → IsZero (J.homology k))
      (e0 : J.homology 0 ≅ SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
      (eG : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G ≅
        (homComplex (R := Z.sheaf) T J).homology (n : ℤ))
      (eQ : Q ≅ T.homology (-(n : ℤ))),
      ∀ (V : Z.Opens) (U : Y.affineOpens)
        (_hU : ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
          Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
            RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f),
        let W := V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        let Fc := moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor Z V W
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective (Fc.obj J) ∧
          HasFiniteFreeZeroModel (V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W) (Fc.obj T)
